1.asv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

2.web: “Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
2.asv: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of my haste that is in me.

3.web: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
3.asv: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame; And the spirit of my understanding answereth me.

4.web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
4.asv: Knowest thou notthis of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,

5.web: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
5.asv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?

6.web: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
6.asv: Though his height mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;

7.web: yet he shall perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him shall say, ‘Where is he?’
7.asv: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They that have seen him shall say, Where is he?

8.web: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found. Yes, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.
8.asv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

9.web: The eye which saw him shall see him no more, neither shall his place any more see him.
9.asv: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

10.web: His children shall seek the favor of the poor. His hands shall give back his wealth.
10.asv: His children shall seek the favor of the poor, And his hands shall give back his wealth.

11.web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth shall lie down with him in the dust.
11.asv: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.

12.web: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
12.asv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue,

13.web: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
13.asv: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;

14.web: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
14.asv: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

15.web: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
15.asv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God will cast them out of his belly.

16.web: He shall suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue shall kill him.
16.asv: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper’s tongue shall slay him.

17.web: He shall not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
17.asv: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and butter.

18.web: That for which he labored he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down. According to the substance that he has gotten, he shall not rejoice.
18.asv: That which he labored for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

19.web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
19.asv: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

20.web: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he shall not save anything of that in which he delights.
20.asv: Because he knew no quietness within him, He shall not save aught of that wherein he delighteth.

21.web: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity shall not endure.
21.asv: There was nothing left that he devoured not; Therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

22.web: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress shall overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery shall come on him.
22.asv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.

23.web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
23.asv: When he is about to fill his belly, Godwill cast the fierceness of his wrath upon him, And will rain it upon him while he is eating.

24.web: He shall flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow shall strike him through.
24.asv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of brass shall strike him through.

25.web: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
25.asv: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.

26.web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire shall devour him. It shall consume that which is left in his tent.
26.asv: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: A fire not blown by man shall devour him; It shall consume that which is left in his tent.

27.web: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity. The earth shall rise up against him.
27.asv: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.

28.web: The increase of his house shall depart. They shall rush away in the day of his wrath.
28.asv: The increase of his house shall depart; His goodsshall flow away in the day of his wrath.

29.web: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
29.asv: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.
